positions.stance: Calls high property taxes the biggest challenge; wants to lower them by expanding the tax base. Supports growth that "brings opportunity while protecting the character of our community."
Says he opposes residential growth, which he argues raises taxes, and wants industrial growth at the county's four I-85 interchanges.
Wants a cooperative county-city water plan, prioritizing high-need areas in the short term.
Short term: "Unite Franklin County" through county-city cooperation. Longer term: lower taxes, welcome industrial growth, support farmers and schools.
